_comment: Grandfather baseline for scripts/validate-agents.py per MIT-413. Files listed here carry non-spec frontmatter keys that Claude Code's loader silently ignores; the validator WARNs on them, and any other file with non-spec keys HARD-fails so new debt can't slip in. 2026-06-19: color+skills became official agent fields, emptying the agents list. 2026-10-14: the four skills' `references:` moved under the official `metadata:` map, emptying the skills list. Both lists are now empty, so every non-spec key HARD-fails; this file can be deleted (the validator treats a missing file as an empty baseline).
